claims: World Quantum Day is celebrated every April 14.
The date 4/14 pays homage to the first digits of Planck's constant (4.14×10−15 eV⋅s).
Planck's constant is a fundamental number in quantum physics.
World Quantum Day was launched by scientists from more than 65 countries.
World Quantum Day activities include talks.
World Quantum Day activities include laboratory visits.
World Quantum Day activities include webinars.
World Quantum Day activities include educational events.
World Quantum Day activities occur around the world.
The official website of World Quantum Day is worldquantumday.org.
